home.title: Transcribe and summarize
home.subtitle: Import an audio or video file, or record from your microphone. NoteTaker transcribes it with Whisper and writes a summary.
home.formats: MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC, OGG, MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM and more
home.warnNoModel: No Whisper model has been downloaded for local transcription.
home.warnNoOpenAIKeyTranscription: Transcribing with OpenAI requires an OpenAI API key.
home.warnNoSummaryKey: Add an API key (Anthropic or OpenAI) or connect your ChatGPT account to generate summaries.
home.warnProviderKey: The selected summary provider has no account or API key configured.

recorder.title: Record from microphone
recorder.micDenied: No microphone access. Check your system permissions.

entry.waiting: The transcript will appear here when it's done.

summary.empty: There is no summary for this transcript yet.

transcription.engineLocalDesc: Whisper (whisper.cpp) on your computer. Free, private and works offline.
transcription.engineOpenAIDesc: Whisper in OpenAI's cloud. Fast, no downloads; billed per minute of audio.
transcription.modelsHint: Larger models are more accurate but slower. “Large v3 Turbo (Q5)” is a good balance.
transcription.gpu: Use the GPU (Metal / CUDA) when available
transcription.openaiModelHint: “whisper-1” returns per-segment timestamps; gpt-*-transcribe models return text only.

summary.modelHint: Type a model id or pick one from the list.
summary.effortHint: More effort gives more careful summaries, but takes longer and costs more.
summary.chatgptModelHint: Models included in your ChatGPT plan. Use the button to load them.

keys.hint: Keys are encrypted with the system keychain (Keychain / DPAPI) and only used by the app's main process.
keys.encryptionUnavailable: System encryption is unavailable: keys can't be saved.
keys.modeApiKeyDesc: Pay as you go in the provider console.
keys.modeAccountDesc: Uses your Plus or Pro plan.

accounts.chatgptHint: Requires ChatGPT Plus or Pro. Usage counts toward your plan limits, and you can cap how much NoteTaker uses in your ChatGPT settings. Tokens are encrypted with the system keychain.
accounts.noTranscription: The account only covers summaries: transcribing with OpenAI still needs an API key.

templates.name: Name
templates.promptHint: Describe what you want (sections, format, level of detail). The transcript and output language are added automatically.
templates.emptyCustom: You don't have custom templates yet.

update.title: Updates
update.readyToInstall: Ready to install. It will be applied when the app restarts.
update.manualHint: Download the installer and replace the current app.
update.notConfigured: Updates aren't configured in this build.

errors.NO_API_KEY_ANTHROPIC: Missing Anthropic API key. Add it in Settings → Accounts & API keys.
errors.NO_API_KEY_OPENAI: Missing OpenAI API key. Add it, or connect your ChatGPT account, in Settings → Accounts & API keys.
errors.NO_LOCAL_MODEL: The selected Whisper model isn't downloaded. Download it in Settings → Transcription.
errors.WHISPER_BINARY_MISSING: The whisper.cpp executable wasn't found. Run “npm run whisper:fetch”.
errors.FFMPEG_FAILED: Couldn't read audio from the file
errors.EMPTY_TRANSCRIPT: No speech was detected in the audio.
errors.AUTH_FAILED: The API key is invalid or lacks permissions.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: API rate limit reached. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.NETWORK: Couldn't reach the service. Check your internet connection.
errors.REFUSAL: The model declined to write this summary
errors.OUTPUT_TRUNCATED: The model's response was cut off before finishing.
errors.UPDATE_FAILED: Couldn't check for or download the update
errors.ACCOUNT_SIGNED_OUT: The account session expired or was signed out. Reconnect it in Settings → Accounts & API keys.
errors.ACCOUNT_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This account cannot be used from NoteTaker: it needs ChatGPT Plus or Pro, or permission was denied.
errors.USAGE_LIMIT: Your plan’s usage limit was reached. Wait for it to reset or review usage in your account settings.
